notes: This contract records portable C++ TCK checks for the official IEEE 1516.1 unconditional attribute ownership divestiture service. The source uses only the standard RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. The multi-recipient scenario verifies the If Available and regular acquisition outcomes, a standard ownership-assumption offer, explicit callback servicing, exact callback metadata and tag preservation, unpublished-candidate filtering, and a subsequent If Available acquisition after divestiture. The mixed-set atomicity scenario starts with two owned attributes, transfers one to another joined federate, then submits both in a single unconditional-divestiture call; it checks the AttributeNotOwned exception, unchanged ownership of the remaining valid attribute, retained ownership by the other federate, and absence of partial ownership callbacks. Neither scenario asserts provider-specific names, registries, headers, transport, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador unconditionalAttributeOwnershipDivestiture, attributeOwnershipAcquisition, attributeOwnershipAcquisitionIfAvailable, and evokeCallback services with FederateAmbassador discovery, requestAttributeOwnershipAssumption, and attributeOwnershipAcquisitionNotification callbacks
